zh.title: 跨境电商独立站：建站 · 支付 · 合规 · 增长
zh.subtitle: 从 0 搭建一个能收全球款的独立站，并跑通物流、税务与广告投放
zh.tagline: 写给技术背景卖家的跨境电商实战课：不只教你点 Shopify 后台，而是理解支付、风控、合规与转化的完整链路。
audience: 有技术能力、想自建品牌独立站而不是只做平台铺货的卖家
已在 Amazon / 平台开店，想沉淀自己的流量与用户资产
为跨境客户交付建站与支付集成的开发者、外包团队
做 DTC 小品牌：需要把合规、物流和支付一次做对
outcomes: 判断该用 Shopify、Shopline 还是 Next.js 自建站，以及三者的成本边界
配置多币种收款：Stripe、PayPal、支付宝/微信（可行方案）与分期
设计降低拒付率的支付流程：3DS、风控规则、订单审核
跑通跨境物流：头程、尾程、海外仓与退货方案的成本对比
处理 VAT / OSS / 关税与隐私合规（GDPR / CCPA）
用 AI 批量生产商品文案、图片与视频素材，并做广告素材 A/B
deliverables: 独立站上线检查清单（域名、支付、物流、税务、法务共 78 项）
支付渠道与费率对比表（按目标市场给出推荐组合）
广告素材脚本模板与 AI 生成工作流
退货 / 拒付 / 客诉处理话术库（中英双语）

modules.title: 模块 1 · 出海电商全景与选品
modules.summary: 先选对市场和品类，再谈建站。
lessons: 平台店 vs 独立站：流量成本、复购与品牌资产的取舍
目标市场选择：北美、欧洲、东南亚、中东的支付与物流差异
选品方法：从供应链优势到需求验证的 4 个数据源
定价模型：含运费、关税、广告成本的毛利测算表

modules.title: 模块 2 · 建站选型与落地
modules.summary: 用最少的维护成本换来最快的上线速度。
lessons: Shopify / Shopline / WooCommerce / Next.js 自建：决策树
Shopify 主题与结账流程定制（含 Checkout Extensibility）
自建站方案：Next.js + 无头电商 API + Stripe
站点性能：Core Web Vitals 对转化与广告质量分的影响
多语言与多币种站点结构（子目录 vs 子域）

modules.title: 模块 3 · 支付与风控
modules.summary: 收款能力决定你能卖到哪个国家。
lessons: Stripe 跨境收款：账户主体、结算周期、费率与拒付责任
PayPal / 支付宝 / 微信支付的接入条件与现实限制
多币种定价与汇率策略：本地货币展示 vs 美元结算
3DS / SCA 与支付成功率：为什么欧洲必须做
风控与拒付预防：地址校验、风险规则、人工审核阈值
退款、部分退款与争议（dispute）处理流程

modules.title: 模块 4 · 物流与履约
modules.summary: 跨境体验的一半是物流。
lessons: 头程 / 尾程 / 海外仓：三种履约模式的成本模型
物流商选择与时效承诺（含追踪页与异常处理）
关税与 DDP / DDU：收件人体验与成本的平衡
退货方案：本地退货地址、退货率控制与二次销售

modules.title: 模块 5 · 合规与税务
modules.summary: 合规不是成本，是不被下架的前提。
lessons: VAT / OSS / 销售税：什么规模开始必须注册
隐私合规：Cookie 同意、数据跨境、GDPR / CCPA 最小实现
商品合规：CE / FCC / 电池 / 化妆品的认证要求
广告合规：Meta / Google 的禁售与宣称限制
法务页模板：条款、隐私、退款、配送政策

modules.title: 模块 6 · AI 内容与素材生产
modules.summary: 用 AI 把内容成本降到原来的十分之一。
lessons: 商品文案：多语言卖点提炼与 SEO 标题生成
图片与场景图：AI 生成 + 实拍结合的合规用法
短视频脚本与批量剪辑工作流
落地页与广告素材的 A/B 实验设计

modules.title: 模块 7 · 广告投放与转化
modules.summary: 先算清单位经济模型，再开预算。
lessons: Meta / Google / TikTok 的冷启动结构与最小预算
广告素材测试矩阵：hook、卖点、场景的组合
转化率优化：商品页、购物车、结账页的漏斗诊断
弃购挽回与邮件 / SMS 自动化

modules.title: 模块 8 · 数据与复购
modules.summary: 把一次性买家变成复购用户。
lessons: 核心指标：AOV、CAC、LTV、退款率与真实毛利
会员 / 订阅 / 捆绑销售：提升 LTV 的三种做法
评论与 UGC：合规收集与展示
季度复盘模板与下一步扩张决策

faq.a: 预计 2027 年 1 月完成主体内容并交付。预售期间可享受早鸟价，并优先参与案例拆解；如果延期超过 30 天，可无条件全额退款。
这门课假设你有基本的建站或开发能力。完全没有电商经验也能跟，但需要投入更多时间在模块 1 和 2 的基础概念上。

faq.q: 课程会讲 Amazon 平台运营吗？
faq.a: 不会深入。课程聚焦独立站（DTC）的建站、支付、合规与增长；平台运营只在选型对比时提及。

faq.q: 涉及具体服务商推荐吗？
faq.a: 会给出对比维度与费率表，而不是唯一推荐；不同目标市场的最优组合不一样，课程会教你怎么自己判断。

faq.q: 预售付款后能马上看吗？
faq.a: 预售用户会先获得已完成章节与资料包（模块 1-2 先行版），正式上线后自动解锁全部内容。

en.title: Cross-border Commerce: Storefront, Payments, Compliance, Growth
en.subtitle: Build an independent store that can take payments worldwide and survive logistics, tax and ads
en.tagline: A practical course for technical sellers: not just clicking around a Shopify admin, but understanding payments, risk, compliance and conversion end to end.
audience: Technical sellers who want a branded DTC store instead of marketplace arbitrage
Amazon or marketplace sellers building owned traffic and customer data
Developers and agencies delivering storefronts and payment integrations
Small DTC brands that need compliance, logistics and payments done right once
outcomes: Choose between Shopify, Shopline and a custom Next.js storefront with clear cost boundaries
Configure multi-currency payments: Stripe, PayPal, Alipay/WeChat where viable, and instalments
Design a checkout that reduces disputes: 3DS, risk rules, manual review thresholds
Run cross-border logistics: first mile, last mile, overseas warehousing and returns
Handle VAT/OSS, duties and privacy compliance (GDPR/CCPA)
Produce product copy, images and video with AI, then A/B test the creative
deliverables: A 78-item store launch checklist (domain, payments, logistics, tax, legal)
Payment provider and fee comparison with recommended stacks per market
Ad creative script templates and an AI production workflow
Refund, dispute and support response scripts (bilingual)

modules.title: Module 1 · Landscape and product selection
modules.summary: Pick the market and product before the storefront.
lessons: Marketplace vs independent store: traffic cost, repeat purchase, brand equity
Market selection: payments and logistics differences across US, EU, SEA and MENA
Product selection: four data sources from supply advantage to demand validation
Pricing model: margin sheet including shipping, duties and ad cost

modules.title: Module 2 · Storefront build
modules.summary: Fastest launch at the lowest maintenance cost.
lessons: Shopify, Shopline, WooCommerce or custom Next.js: a decision tree
Shopify theme and checkout customisation (Checkout Extensibility)
Custom stack: Next.js plus a headless commerce API plus Stripe
Site performance: Core Web Vitals, conversion and ad quality scores
Multilingual and multi-currency site structure: subdirectory vs subdomain

modules.title: Module 3 · Payments and risk
modules.summary: Your payment stack decides which countries you can sell to.
lessons: Stripe for cross-border: entity, payout schedule, fees and dispute liability
PayPal, Alipay and WeChat Pay: eligibility and real-world constraints
Multi-currency pricing and FX strategy: local display vs USD settlement
3DS / SCA and authorisation rates: why Europe requires it
Risk and dispute prevention: AVS, risk rules, manual review thresholds
Refunds, partial refunds and dispute response

modules.title: Module 4 · Logistics and fulfilment
modules.summary: Half of the cross-border experience is shipping.
lessons: First mile, last mile, overseas warehousing: three fulfilment cost models
Carrier selection, delivery promises, tracking pages and exceptions
Duties and DDP vs DDU: balancing recipient experience and cost
Returns: local return addresses, return-rate control, resale

modules.title: Module 5 · Compliance and tax
modules.summary: Compliance is the price of staying listed.
lessons: VAT, OSS and sales tax: when registration becomes mandatory
Privacy: cookie consent, cross-border data, minimum GDPR/CCPA implementation
Product compliance: CE, FCC, batteries, cosmetics
Advertising compliance: Meta and Google restricted claims
Legal page templates: terms, privacy, refunds, shipping

modules.title: Module 6 · AI content production
modules.summary: Cut content cost by an order of magnitude.
lessons: Product copy: multilingual benefit extraction and SEO titles
Images and lifestyle shots: combining AI generation with real photography
Short-video scripts and batch editing workflows
Landing page and ad creative A/B experiments

modules.title: Module 7 · Advertising and conversion
modules.summary: Know your unit economics before you spend.
lessons: Meta, Google and TikTok cold start structures and minimum budgets
Creative test matrix: hook, benefit, scenario combinations
Conversion optimisation: product, cart and checkout funnel diagnosis
Abandoned cart recovery, email and SMS automation

modules.title: Module 8 · Data and retention
modules.summary: Turn one-time buyers into repeat customers.
lessons: Core metrics: AOV, CAC, LTV, refund rate and true margin
Memberships, subscriptions and bundles to raise LTV
Reviews and UGC: compliant collection and display
Quarterly review template and expansion decisions

faq.a: Core content is scheduled for January 2027. Pre-orders get the early-bird price and early access to case breakdowns; if launch slips more than 30 days you can cancel for a full refund.

faq.q: I am completely new — is this too advanced?
faq.a: The course assumes basic web or development literacy. No ecommerce experience is required, but you will spend more time on modules 1 and 2.

faq.q: Do you cover Amazon marketplace operations?
faq.a: Not in depth. The focus is DTC storefronts: build, payments, compliance and growth. Marketplaces appear only in the comparison.
You get comparison dimensions and fee tables rather than a single recommendation, because the best stack depends on your target market.

faq.q: Can I watch immediately after pre-ordering?
faq.a: Pre-order buyers get the finished chapters and resource packs first (modules 1-2 preview), then everything unlocks at launch.
